title: Hold a licence to grow or process industrial hemp
what: Possess, cultivate or supply industrial hemp only under a licence and only for its licensed purpose.

sources.title: Industrial Hemp Act 2015 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is the holder of a licence – (a) must not possess, cultivate or supply hemp or industrial hemp otherwise than for the purpose for which the licence is granted

sources.title: Industrial Hemp Act 2015 (Tas)
sources.quote: The Secretary must not grant a licence to an applicant unless satisfied that the applicant is a fit and proper person to be involved in the possession, cultivation or supply of hemp or industrial hemp
